field_evidence.dataset_statement: Animal rescue special-service incidents attended by LFB are published from January 2009; incident records include location information such as postcode, borough and ward.
field_evidence.resource_name: Animal Rescue incidents attended by LFB from Jan 2009.csv

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade 'Animal rescue incidents attended by LFB' dataset. The current resource spans January 2009 through July 2026 and supplies incident location information including postcode, borough and ward. This batch binds the verified Campden ward identity to that unused public-safety source window without claiming an extracted Campden incident row, geometry, parcel join or parcel progress.
